security_spec.violation_condition: FreeBSD kernel S-mode code sets mstatus.TW=0 under the mistaken assumption that this permits WFI execution in U-mode, or U-mode WFI is not properly handled in the illegal-instruction trap path (do_trap_user / trap.c), potentially allowing a user process to stall a hart in U-mode if the implementation treats WFI as a no-op within the bounded-time exception window.
security_spec.summary: Spec clarifies that mstatus.TW does NOT control U-mode WFI trapping—WFI in U-mode always raises illegal-instruction regardless of TW; FreeBSD's S-mode trap handler must unconditionally deliver SIGILL, and kernel code must not rely on TW=0 to 'enable' U-mode WFI
